property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and any recipient address, after owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) (sending the contract any Ether beforehand), the reference contract always ends with address(c).balance == 0; the mutant that first transfers the full balance to owner can cause the overall call to succeed while leaving non-zero balance in c for some adversarial recipient behaviour (or cause different distribution), so the property distinguishes them.
change_summary: Swap transfer to owner and then to recipient by first transferring full balance to owner, making recipient receive nothing (order change causing different end-state).
